at steps 1 the linear model's squared error is 287 times smaller than repeating the last value: the series is nearly deterministic (smooth or periodic). There the attainable linear gain has no finite bound (it is set by the noise floor and by how much memory the model gets), so read these rungs as 'almost perfectly forecastable' rather than as a precise amount, and compare models by ratios, not by percentages, which are all close to 100%.
